scope: Read-only inspection of installed native UI and local browser availability; no server, tunnel, browser session, search, evaluation or LLM call started by this audit.

native_cli.db_flag_scope: Initial browser URL only; does not restrict accessible databases.
native_cli.root_scope: Recursive database discovery and path prefix; not a reliable access-control boundary.

http_methods.database_reads: ProgramDatabase and SystemPromptDatabase use read_only=True / mode=ro; failed-proposal and statistics helper queries use ordinary sqlite3.connect. Inspected handlers issue SELECT and PRAGMA statements; no search or mutation endpoint.
http_methods.get_side_effect: download_meta_pdf creates/removes temporary files and may spawn wkhtmltopdf/pandoc.

endpoints./list_databases: Recursively discovers .db/.sqlite below root; exclude this scan or constrain root to current campaign.
endpoints./get_programs: Full program records, including code, metadata, private_metrics and text_feedback; five-second cache.
endpoints./get_programs_summary: Code/embedding-free summaries but includes metadata, private_metrics and text_feedback.
endpoints./get_program_count: Count and max timestamp; used for three-second change detection.
endpoints./get_program_details: Selected source, diff, feedback and metadata; may resolve failed-proposal artifacts from recorded paths.
endpoints./get_system_prompts: Sibling prompts.sqlite when present; currently optional UI capability.
endpoints./get_database_stats: Aggregate count, best score, estimated cost and timing.
endpoints./get_meta_files: Lists meta_*.txt and exposes absolute file paths.
endpoints./get_meta_content: Reads recommendation/meta text; processed_count should be restricted to numeric values by wrapper.
endpoints./download_meta_pdf: Temporary-file and subprocess work; unnecessary for live browsing.
endpoints./get_plots: Lists gen_<generation>/results/plots raster files; generation should be validated numerically.
endpoints./plot_file/: Reads arbitrary file bytes under string-prefix path check; extensions are not restricted.

path_boundary_findings: DB and metadata endpoints join search_root with caller db_path, without resolve/commonpath containment; absolute paths and parent traversals are accepted by the path construction.
plot_file uses abspath(...).startswith(abspath(root)), which does not enforce a directory boundary or resolve symlink targets.
Failed-proposal source paths can come from saved metadata and are not independently constrained by the native handler.
Static fallback serves package webui directory and inherits directory listing; a wrapper can restrict exact known assets instead.

recommended_local_access.server: Repository-owned wrapper importing the installed native DatabaseRequestHandler and serving the unchanged native HTML; bind127.0.0.1 only.
recommended_local_access.query_validation: Require db_path exactly programs.sqlite; numeric generation/processed_count; known program IDs or validated native failed-node IDs; reject duplicate/unknown path parameters.
recommended_local_access.remote_access: Do not publish raw upstream CLI. Root owns any subsequent access decision; local WSL localhost access can be tested first.

exports: Plotly chart images where modebar enabled
live_and_visual_features.chromatic_field: Native plots use upstream styling. Screenshots or browser-generated SVG/canvas inspection can document the UI; publication figures should continue using repository visual_theme.py and actual campaign data.
scientific_limits: UI API cost fields are estimated metadata, not subscription charges.
One model does not establish model-bandit selection.
Embedding/novelty views need actual embedding and judge execution, absent here.
Native database row counts include seed island copies; candidate slots must come from campaign accounting.

agent_browser.implementation: Bundled native Linux binary; daemon does not require Playwright or Node.

browser_availability_at_inspection.needed_for_automated_render: Provide a local Chrome/Chromium executable or download browser binaries under a task-local allowed path; root handles this. Use a separate session and temporary profile, without user authentication state or cloud/AI chat providers.
